the immediate post-CCTA FLASH sweep, and the 5-min LIE scan.
CARE Dose 4D and CARE keV are used with a reference image qual
ity (IQ) level of 64. CARE Dose 4D adapts tube current in real time
based on patient attenuation from the topogram, targeting the set
IQ level (a vendor noise/SNR surrogate) rather than a fixed mAs;
CARE keV is photon-counting–specific and optimizes dose while
maintaining SNR/CNR at predefined keV settings. Exam-type pre
sets (e.g. vascular) and manual kV options (70/90 kV for low-dose
phases; 120/140 kV for high-resolution phases) are available; the
‘off’ mode is not used. These controls maintain image quality while
adhering to ALARA principles. The combined dose-length product
